STRATEGY (from day 1):
1) ROUTINE: put ALL kills in the AFTERNOON (quick entries, and timed entries too). Night workers, students and people at home are all free then, so L only rules out day workers and the routine pool stays at 55% (about 55k).
2) PLACES: L can reach 3 of the 5 kinds (regional, sector, age, forum, foreign). If he learns all 3 of my places for those kinds, the pool falls below 1000 and I'm caught. If he learns only 2, the pool is about 2.7k-3.4k, which is safe. So: find ONE kind H that is surely reachable (a trace attributable only to it) and never kill its criminals again. That includes any criminal tagged with H's place. Then the other 4 kinds hold at most 2 reachable kinds and I can kill freely from them. National kills are always safe.
3) PROBING: on a probe day, kill only national + the 2 criminals of one kind X. If deaths_traced goes up, X is reachable: set H = X (X then has at most 2 traces, so it's safe). If there is no increase, X is less likely to be reachable (about 33% after one day). Then probe another kind the next day, alone again so any increase can be attributed.
Probe order: sector (gazette) first. Sector is the best H to hold back, since leaving its factor of 0.2 out of the pool gives a bigger final pool. Next: radio, then West, forum, foreign.
Once H is known: kill everything except H criminals (up to 10 quick + 2 timed, all afternoon). That aims at 40+ deaths in 5 days for the x4 multiplier.
4) WATCH THE POOL: about 55k means routine info only. About 10k means 1 kind learned. About 3k means 2 learned; then be extra careful. If it drops below about 2000, cut back to national only.
